lines.trans: Good evening. What is going on?
Mr. Norman Thavaud was speeding.
The judge could take away his license.
May I see him?
This way. He is in the sobering-up cell.
What are you playing at? You don't want to do the film anymore?
He already thinks that I am a loser.
Stop it, he cast you, you convinced him.
He is not from my world, not my universe.
I am going to make a fool of myself.
Call him, cancel and let's get it over with.
Hello Jacques. It is Gabriel Sarda.
Norman does not want to do your movie.
Do not raise your voice!
Have you been drinking?
Are you locking me up too?
I am a failure.
Not at all. You were cast in an Audiard movie.
